answer: Bind each identity to one blood-donor record from a blood bank: donor ID, dates and screening registry-checked, one donor per identity, with the minimum interval enforced. One donor backs one identity, like one boat at a jetty. A farm chasing the nectar of rewards must recruit one real, eligible donor per fake, pass screening and wait out the interval; a history cannot be built from timber paperwork alone, as spaced donations take months. A shared donor ID or impossible frequency merges the cluster into one weight and revokes it, so fakes multiply people, visits and waiting, not compute.
